description: Survey-level snapshot of a single repo found while seeding from local work. Apoha-bounded: signals only, no deep code read. Captures the SHAPE of the user's work at this repo without committing to mechanism.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the repo on disk.

primary_language.description: Inferred from file-extension distribution + manifest files. Null if mixed/unclear.

manifest_files.description: Detected manifest files: package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, go.mod, etc.

readme_h1.description: First H1 line of README (≤200 chars), if present.

readme_first_lines.description: First 200 chars of README body for context.

has_claude_md.description: Whether the repo has a CLAUDE.md.

has_dot_claude.description: Whether the repo has a .claude/ directory (subagents, commands, hooks).

has_dot_coltrane.description: Whether the repo has a .coltrane/ directory (already coltrane-flavored).

commit_rhythm_30d.description: Number of commits in the last 30 days.

top_directories.description: Top-level subdirectory names (e.g. src/, tests/, docs/) — structural hint.

survey_completeness.description: Honest signal-bound: did we hit the scan limits or get clean reads on every channel?
